method: RC6 reproduction and candidate are direct Node/jsdom standalone exports of fixtures/rc6/user-trigonometry.md. CSS was compared independently with the installed KaTeX stylesheet after removing package @font-face rules; embedded fonts are handled separately. Baseline failure is intentionally retained as evidence.
rootCause: Vitest 5.1.0 defaults to disabling CSS transforms; its post transform emits an empty string even for katex.min.css?raw. The production Vite bundle already used the correct layout.

limits: This comparison measures the CSS bytes and programmatic output. It does not measure browser layout, installed-font decoding, OS clipboard or native printer dialogs.

embeddedFontDecode.method: FreeType FT_New_Memory_Face opens each embedded WOFF2 from the saved HTML; FT_Load_Char with FT_LOAD_RENDER rasterizes up to four mapped characters per font at 20 pixels. This validates the font payload independently of browser layout.
